The '''Royal District''' was a district of [[Cinnagar]], a [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Empress Teta]], that was a home to the royal [[Keto family]].

==Description==
A district in the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Cinnagar]], the Royal District bordered the [[Core District]] and consisted of nine [[gold]]en spires, each representing a different [[Planet|world]] in the [[Empress Teta system]]. They sat along the equatorial axis, aligned in such a way that the morning [[Empress Teta system's star|sun]] hit them in the same order in which they [[orbit]]ed their [[star]]. The [[Tetan Royal Palace]] stood at the center, a complex of the spires connected by low walls.<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
Locals on the planet insisted that the [[Iron Citadel]] formed the foundations of the modern Tetan Royal Palace, while a small minority believed that it was buried deep beneath the spires of the Royal District and served as a shrine for surviving [[Krath]] loyalists.<ref name="NoP" />
